subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 1 – Lesson 6: English in action (Sharing your toys)
outcomes: I can ask politely: Can I play with it, please?
I can answer: Yes, of course. Let's play together.
I can share my toys with my friends.

tf.s: Can I play with it, please? is a polite question.

tf.why: Great! We play together when we share.

tf.s: We say please when we want something.
tf.why: Yes! please is a polite word.
Yes, of course. means Yes, happily!

tf.s: It's good to take a friend's toy without asking.
tf.why: We ask first: Can I play with it, please?

tf.s: Let's play together. means we play with each other.
tf.why: Well done! together means with each other.

tf.s: It's my new scooter. tells about a toy.
tf.why: Yes! It tells us the scooter is new.

tf.s: Is it a car? (a ball) Yes, it is.
tf.why: It's a ball, so we say No, it isn't.

tf.s: Can I play with it, ...? The missing word is thank.
Is it an action figure? (an action figure) No, it isn't.
tf.why: It is an action figure, so we say Yes, it is.
